content:
Company will ring the opening bell at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York's Times Square on Wednesday, July 29.

ATLANTA, July 28, 2026 --( BUSINESS WIRE )--QumulusAI (Nasdaq: QMLS), a neocloud infrastructure provider purpose-built for the AI computing era, today announced it will ring the opening bell at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York's Times Square on Wednesday, July 29. The live broadcast will begin at 9:15 a.m. EDT on nasdaq.com/marketsite/bell-ringing-ceremony.

"Ringing the Nasdaq bell is a milestone moment in a company's life, and it is a privilege to mark ours," said Michael Maniscalco, CEO of QumulusAI. "We are grateful to the employees, board members, investors, partners and customers who helped us reach this point, and it means a great deal to celebrate it together on Nasdaq's stage."

QumulusAI is a distributed AI cloud platform that delivers accelerated access to high-performance GPU compute. Through an inference-first, demand-led deployment model across a network of data center sites, QumulusAI brings compute closer to customer demand, helping AI teams and enterprises scale production AI workloads with speed, flexibility and control. By combining rapid deployment with flexible private cloud infrastructure, QumulusAI gives customers a faster, more adaptable path beyond the capacity constraints of traditional centralized and hyperscale cloud models. Learn more at QumulusAI.com .

Follow us on LinkedIn and X @QumulusAI .

chineseTitle: QumulusAI 敲响纳斯达克开盘钟
chineseSummary: 亚特兰大，2026 年 7 月 28 日——专为人工智能计算时代打造的新云基础设施提供商 QumulusAI（纳斯达克代码：QMLS）今天宣布将于 7 月 29 日星期三在纽约时代广场的纳斯达克 MarketSite 敲响开盘钟。直播将于美国东部时间上午 9:15 在 nasdaq.com/marketsite/bell-ringing-ceremony 开始。
chineseContent:
公司将于 7 月 29 日星期三在纽约时代广场的纳斯达克市场敲响开盘钟。

亚特兰大，2026 年 7 月 28 日 --(美国商业资讯)--专为人工智能计算时代打造的新云基础设施提供商 QumulusAI（纳斯达克股票代码：QMLS）今天宣布将于 7 月 29 日星期三在纽约时代广场的纳斯达克 MarketSite 敲响开盘钟。直播将于美国东部时间上午 9:15 开始。 nasdaq.com/marketsite/bell-ringing-ceremony。

QumulusAI 首席执行官 Michael Maniscalco 表示：“敲响纳斯达克的钟声是公司生命中的一个里程碑时刻，我们很荣幸能够纪念这一时刻。” “我们感谢帮助我们实现这一目标的员工、董事会成员、投资者、合作伙伴和客户，在纳斯达克的舞台上共同庆祝这一点意义重大。”

QumulusAI 是一个分布式 AI 云平台，可加速访问高性能 GPU 计算。通过跨数据中心站点网络的推理优先、需求主导的部署模型，QumulusAI 使计算更接近客户需求，帮助 AI 团队和企业快速、灵活和可控地扩展生产 AI 工作负载。通过将快速部署与灵活的私有云基础设施相结合，QumulusAI 为客户提供了一条更快、适应性更强的路径，超越了传统集中式超大规模云模型的容量限制。请访问 QumulusAI.com 了解更多信息。
